<!--
  The event intro (model event@1): an optional badge, the name of the event as a large heading, a description,
  the date and the place as a list of two facts, and one action. Text only. The align setting places it: centred
  or at the start.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type EventIntroProps = {
    id: string;
    badge?: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    date: string;
    place: string;
    actionLabel?: string;
    actionHref?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    badge = "",
    title,
    description = "",
    date,
    place,
    actionLabel = "",
    actionHref = "",
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: EventIntroProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const facts = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "justify-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "justify-end"
    : "justify-start"
  );
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="event-intro"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="6" align={column}>
      {#if badge}
        <Badge variant="secondary">
          {badge}
        </Badge>
      {/if}
      <Title as={level} size="5xl" weight="bold" class={cn("max-w-4xl tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
        {title}
      </Title>
      {#if description}
        <Text size="lg" class={cn("max-w-2xl text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
          {description}
        </Text>
      {/if}
      <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", cn("flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-2", facts))}>
        <ListItem data-slot="event-date">
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
            {date}
          </Text>
        </ListItem>
        <ListItem data-slot="event-place">
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
            {place}
          </Text>
        </ListItem>
      </List>
      {#if (actionLabel && actionHref)}
        <LinkButton variant="default" size="lg" href={urlOf(actionHref)}>
          {actionLabel}
        </LinkButton>
      {/if}
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
